items.summary:
I'm building a RAG app with LangChain. Retrieval returns a list of chunks, each with an ID such as doc_3. The model answers with citations like [doc_3], but sometimes it cites an ID that was never retrieved. I already check every cited ID against the retrieved list in code and reject unknown IDs.
